title: Makar Sankranti + Pongal greeting 2027
hook: Happy Makar Sankranti and Pongal from all of us at Galvor.
caption:
Happy Makar Sankranti and Pongal from all of us at Galvor.

Kites over the terrace in one part of the country, a pot of pongal boiling over in another, til-gul passed around in a third. One harvest, many ways to say thank you.

Wishing you clear skies, a full table and a sweet year ahead.
alt_text: Festival card in Galvor violet and gold with a kite motif. It reads Happy Sankranti and Pongal, then: clear skies, a full table and a sweet year ahead. Below: from all of us at Galvor.

slides.headline: Clear skies, a full table and *a sweet year ahead*.
slides.sub: Happy Pongal too, from all of us at Galvor.

notes:
Greeting only, no marketing lesson. No numbers used. The greeting field is limited to about 22 characters, so the card says "Happy Sankranti" and the sub line carries Pongal.
